rv.q: This is a meticulously conceived production that reinvents Miller without ever getting in the way of the view.

This sleek, minimalist staging helps the production to feel as tightly, and inexorably, wound as a Greek tragedy, as Eddie hurtles blindly to his inevitable fate and we wait in horrified yet thrilled anticipation.

I recommend it but I can't help observing that I was far more swept away by Miller's vision of an ordinary guy felled by epic forces in the production starring Ken Stott that played just around the corner only five years ago.
This is theater as an out of body experience.

cn.t: Ivo van Hove's stripped-back staging earns acclaim as a definitive, intensely gripping production. Critics praise Mark Strong's brooding performance and the production's menacing, distilled power that holds audiences in sustained tension.
